description: Cross-language baseline: secret detection and control metadata.

controls.title: Input validation
controls.description: Untrusted input is constrained at a trusted server-side layer.

controls.title: Authentication
controls.description: Identity is established with an active, securely configured mechanism.

controls.title: Authorization
controls.description: Sensitive operations and objects require explicit permission.

controls.title: Secrets management
controls.description: Credentials are not stored in source and are loaded from a managed provider.

controls.title: Injection prevention
controls.description: Queries and OS commands cannot be structurally altered by untrusted input.

rules.title: Hardcoded credential
rules.message: A credential-like value is assigned literally in source or configuration.
rules.remediation: Remove the value, rotate it if it was real, and load the secret from a managed provider or environment-specific secret store.

rules.title: Private key material
rules.message: Private key material is present in a scanned file.
rules.remediation: Remove and rotate the key, store it in a hardware-backed or managed secret store, and purge it from history.

rules.title: Recognizable access token
rules.message: A token matching a known credential format is present.
rules.remediation: Revoke the token, remove it from source and history, and load it from a secret provider at runtime.

rules.title: Connection string credential
rules.message: A connection string contains a literal password.
rules.remediation: Use integrated authentication or load the credential from a secret provider; rotate the exposed password.
